title: Aira Villegas, Albert Ian Delos Santos proudly carry PH flag at Asian Games opening ceremony
summary: The country's flagbearers proudly raised the Philippine flag in the 20th Asian Games opening ceremony at the Paloma Mizuho Stadium in Nagoya, Japan.
